description: Test suite for FastAPI dependencies and caching behavior, including counters, sub-dependencies, cache control, and security scopes.

methods.name: dep_counter()
methods.description: Asynchronous dependency function that increments and returns a shared counter.

methods.name: super_dep(count: int = Depends(dep_counter))
methods.description: Asynchronous dependency that depends on dep_counter to demonstrate dependency chaining.

methods.name: get_counter(count: int = Depends(dep_counter))
methods.description: Endpoint that returns the current value of a counter, demonstrating dependency injection.

methods.name: get_sub_counter( subcount: int = Depends(super_dep), count: int = Depends(dep_counter) )
methods.description: Endpoint that uses nested dependencies to return combined counter values.

methods.name: get_sub_counter_no_cache( subcount: int = Depends(super_dep), count: int = Depends(dep_counter, use_cache=False), )
methods.description: Endpoint to test dependency caching behavior by disabling cache.

methods.name: get_scope_counter( count: int = Security(dep_counter), scope_count_1: int = Security(dep_counter, scopes=["scope"]), scope_count_2: int = Security(dep_counter, scopes=["scope"]), )
methods.description: Endpoint demonstrating security scopes and counter increments.

methods.name: test_normal_counter()
methods.description: Test case for /counter/ endpoint to verify counter incrementation.

methods.name: test_sub_counter()
methods.description: Test case for /sub-counter/ endpoint to verify nested dependencies and counters.

methods.name: test_sub_counter_no_cache()
methods.description: Test case for /sub-counter-no-cache/ endpoint to verify cache disabling.

methods.name: test_security_cache()
methods.description: Test case for /scope-counter endpoint to verify security scopes and counter behavior.
